PC: Treat to full remission of symptoms

Try switching to another antidepressant:
Switching to a different SSRI can be effective for achieving remission (TORDIA) and usually best tolerated
Bupropion might help more specifically for anhedonia, poor motivation, fatigue

Behavioral activation techniques:
Increasing activity levels to combat the use of unhealthy behaviors to avoid negative feelings
Examples include taking a walk, waking up at a reasonable time and scheduling an enjoyable activity in the morning, playing on a sports team, or hanging out with a friend – even if they don’t feel like it at the time!
Includes problem solving strategies to reduce barriers
MK: Reevaluate other potential causes of depression/stress/trauma
